evidence: Native lstat observation0755; content attributes/portable.rs validate InodeKind::Symlink mode==0777.
repair: Project emits the existing canonical fixed0777 symlink mode, retaining original native identity/mode for post-read change detection and exact mtime/opaque target. Document this portable representation; no third-party or content-format change. Original failures retained.
